text: vā tampi anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti . sotaṃ ghānaṃ jivhaṃ kāyaṃ manaṃ dhamme manoviññāṇaṃ manosamphassaṃ yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti . evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato evaṃ passato saññojanā samugghātaṃ gacchantīti . tatiyaṃ . [59] kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato āsavā pahīyantīti .pe. catutthaṃ . [60] .pe. āsavā
